pinned.footprints: the verdicts judged the evidence of the Footprints persons of this version

inputs:footprints/viaf-verdicts-2026-10-.title: Footprints: the VIAF numbers of the persons, judged by an LLM (2026-10-26)
inputs:footprints/viaf-verdicts-2026-10-.origin: LLM judging (Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Code agents) of the evidence made by generators/ls-footprints-viaf/evidence.py
inputs:footprints/viaf-verdicts-2026-10-.description: The judgements behind ls-footprints-viaf (decision 0037). evidence.jsonl: for each of the 1,556 VIAF numbers of the persons of footprints 2026-10-26 what both sides say (evidence.py, from the store versions of footprints, record-classes, viaf, gnd and wikidata of 2026-10-26). First pass: ten agents judged the 1,447 links whose cluster is in viaf and not a work, one chunk each, by instruction.md (verdicts-pass1.jsonl: 1,219 correct, 122 wrong, 106 undecidable). Second pass: one agent judged again the 115 links of the first pass's correct that fall under rules the judges had applied differently, by instruction-review.md (review.jsonl: the evidence with the first verdict and why it was reviewed; verdicts-pass2.jsonl: 81 kept, 18 wrong, 16 undecidable). verdicts.tsv: the final verdict per link (person, viaf, verdict, reason, pass): 1,185 correct, 140 wrong, 122 undecidable.
inputs:footprints/viaf-verdicts-2026-10-.note: Not published as such: the decisions file of the linkset gives the outcome and reason of every link.

notes: 1,185 links of 1,556 VIAF numbers of footprints; left out: classes contradict 10, left out: cluster not in the dataset viaf 99, left out: judged undecidable 106, left out: judged undecidable in the second pass 16, left out: judged wrong 122, left out: judged wrong in the second pass 18, linked: judged correct 1,104, linked: judged correct in the second pass 81.
